sharedRules.name: Aegis Shield
sharedRules.description: The zeus Class replaces the Type-2's normal Countermeasures entry of 'A, P5+' with 'A, P3+'.

sharedRules.name: Agility
sharedRules.description: Sirens gain a Passive Countermeasures value of P3+ when taking Falling Masonry hits (since they can often leap out of the way with ease)

sharedRules.name: Command Walker
sharedRules.description: Any Type-2 Squad containing one or more zeus Class Command walkers counts as a Command choice. The Zeus itself is a 'Command' type unit.

sharedRules.name: Drone command
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when the Medusa is within 6”of a building and not embarked in a transport or structure, one friendly infantry squad in that building may gain an additional 5 dice to their CQB pool.

sharedRules.name: Jump In, Jump Out
sharedRules.description: This unit may move its full distance when when entering/abandoning structures. Each entry or exit counts as one embark/disembark movement. The rule may not be used in a turn where the unit interacts with its transport in any way.

sharedRules.name: Jump-Jet Packs
sharedRules.description: This unit may move over terrain/buildings under 6 inches high. It does not count as an aircraft while doing so. Further, dropships do not need to land when Valkyries embark/disemabark. All other rules for embarking/disembarking apply as normal.

sharedRules.name: Levitated
sharedRules.description:
This unit may move over terrain/buildings under 6 inches high. It does not count
as an aircraft while doing so.

sharedRules.name: Repair Nano Machine Wave
sharedRules.description: This ability counts as a weapon shot and follows all the It normally hits on a 1+ (i.e. automatically) and may only be fired against the Medusa that it was bought as a transport for, additionally the Medusa must be damaged. Its accuracy may be modified by such things as command cards and indirect fire in the usual way. A successful hit replaces 1 lost Dp from the target Medusa Unit; The Medusa's Evasion Countermeasures are ignored when rolling to hit for this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Scanning Array
sharedRules.description: This weapon's Ac value may never be modified by more than +1 in total. (i.e. its accuracy can never be worse than 3+)

sharedRules.name: Sunspear
sharedRules.description: This weapon's extreme accuracy allows the tareting of essential systems and chinks in armour. If a roll of 6 is achieved when rolling to hit, 2 Dp are automatically inflicted, in place of rolling to inflict damage. A Passive Countermeasures roll may still be taken before this damage is inflicted.

sharedRules.name: Supercruise
sharedRules.description: The Athena may opt to complete its attack run/intercept at supercruise. When doing so, all enemy AA weapons suffer an additional +1 Ac modifier when firing against the Athena (to a maximum of +6), and all the Athena's weapons suffer the same modifier.

sharedRules.name: White Nanomachines
sharedRules.description:
This ability counts as a weapon shot and follows all the normal rules for weapons (Line of Sight etc). It normally hits on a 1+ (i.e. automatically) and may only be fired against
damaged friendly Units. Its accuracy may be modified by such things as command cards and indirect fire in the usual way. A successful hit replaces 1 lost Dp from the target Vehicle Unit .
